plugins.name: claude-statusbar
plugins.description: Two-line status bar: directory, enriched git, PR, model, session name, context and 5h/7d quotas read natively from the stdin payload.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Interactive PR review workflow: a pending-review walkthrough item by item, GitHub comment processing, and an autonomous review-fix loop.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub API from the standard library: pull requests, review threads, comments, reviews, labels, issues, search and image attachments, without the gh CLI.

plugins.name: norms
plugins.description: Evidence-based code norms: eight review agents, a parallel conformity check, and a learner that turns resolved PR review threads into project rules. Depends on the github plugin.

plugins.name: implement
plugins.description: The feature lifecycle as five commands: brainstorm and plan a feature, run its phases, check a delivery, close the branch, prepare the next one.
